findings.summary: hertz face descriptor marks the cylinder surface cyl_surface as type 'Plane', losing its curvature and geometry.
findings.scenario: Selecting or rendering cyl_surface in the hertz template shows a planar face; any area/normal/contact logic using the descriptor is wrong.
findings.fix: Emit a Cylinder descriptor with radius, axis, centroid and area (or let the generic cylinder branch run).

findings.summary: The home-path scrub regex only matches the literal string '/home/USER/' and its body (\s\"']+) is malformed, so real home/CI paths are never redacted before upload.
findings.scenario: Reviewing a diff that contains /home/runner/work/... or /home/alice/project sends the full path verbatim to api.deepseek.com, contradicting the documented 'inputs are scrubbed of home paths'; macOS /Users/<name> is not handled at all.
findings.fix: Use r"/(?:home|Users)/[^/\s\"']+" -> "/home/USER" and add an APPLEDEV-style /Users/ case; verify with a sample string in a unit test.

findings.summary: Default for contact-pair `search` is provided to units.normalize but `cfg['search']` is indexed directly, so a pair without an explicit search key raises uncaught KeyError (500) instead of defaulting to 1 mm.
findings.scenario: POST change contact_pairs.foo={type:'tied',mu:0} -> cfg['search'] raises KeyError, not caught by (UnitError,ValueError,TypeError) -> HTTP 500 instead of 1 mm default.
findings.fix: Use cfg.get('search') (or cfg.setdefault('search', None)) so the normalize default applies.

findings.summary: tied-parts reads p['gap'] unconditionally, but that template has no gap, so verification raises KeyError.
findings.scenario: Run verification on a tied-parts case -> nonlinear_reference reaches line 416 -> KeyError: 'gap' (500).
findings.fix: Use g = units.to_si(p['gap']) only for gap-blocks; set g = 0 for tied-parts.

findings.summary: gap-blocks uses abs(uz), so a displacement that opens the gap is treated as gap-closing compression.
findings.scenario: gap-blocks with gap=0.1 mm and top uz=+0.5 mm (opening) -> expected F=E*0.4mm/(2h)A even though no contact; reference wrongly rejects a zero-force solver result.
findings.fix: Use the signed compression displacement (e.g. d=max(0,-uz)) before subtracting the gap.

findings.summary: When the instance lock cannot be acquired but no port is published within 10 s, the code falls through, deletes the live instance's running.json and starts a second server without owning the lock.
findings.scenario: First app start takes >10 s to call publish(); user double-clicks a second .nscase -> acquire() fails, poll times out, running.json is deleted and a second uvicorn starts on port 8766, overwriting the port file.
findings.fix: On lock failure, raise SystemExit (or keep retrying) instead of continuing; only unlink running.json on the path where acquire() succeeded.

findings.summary: The server lifetime is tied to the first instance's own window only; a second-start window (opened by a process that returns immediately) is not tracked, so the comment 'ends with its last window' is false.
findings.scenario: App running with window A; user double-clicks another .nscase -> window B opens on the same server; closing window A terminates the process and daemon server, breaking window B (its requests/imports fail).
findings.fix: Track open windows (e.g. window count / idle refcount published alongside the port) and keep the server until the last window closes, or make the second instance own a window and the first wait on all.

findings.summary: On Windows the only candidate scratch root is data_dir(), so when that path is non-ASCII or contains a space the fallback (roots[-1]) returns the same unsafe path and the MinGW OpenFOAM case still runs from an invalid location.
findings.scenario: Windows user '田中' -> data dir 'C:\Users\田中\AppData\...' -> safe() false -> root = data_dir -> wd = C:\Users\田中\...\of -> OpenFOAM mesh/solve fails despite the of_location indirection.
findings.fix: Add an ASCII candidate on Windows (e.g. Path(os.environ['PROGRAMDATA']) or Path(tempfile.gettempdir())) to roots instead of only data_dir().

findings.summary: wait_closed treats removing any pre-existing window/lockfile as proof the window closed, so a stale lock from a crashed browser makes it return immediately after launch.
findings.scenario: A previous browser crashes and leaves data/window/lockfile; the user starts Studio again, wait_closed deletes the stale file and breaks before the new browser creates its lock, then the server exits and the new window loads a dead 127.0.0.1 port.
findings.fix: Remove/ignore stale locks only before launching, or wait until the newly started browser has created its own lock (or the process exits) before returning.

findings.summary: evaluate can return np.inf safety factors (zero-stress nodes / R=1), which serialize to invalid JSON 'Infinity' and can break the API/frontend response.
findings.scenario: Node with vm=0 (unloaded region, R=-1): amp=0 -> se/amp=inf -> sf=inf; JSONResponse emits Infinity, JS JSON.parse throws.
findings.fix: Replace non-finite sf/life with a large finite sentinel before returning/serializing.

findings.summary: Large contact direct solve catches only MemoryError, but MatrixRankWarning is promoted to error inside the same warnings context and escapes, crashing instead of falling back to GMRES.
findings.scenario: Contact saddle system with size in (DIRECT_LIMIT, CONTACT_DIRECT_LIMIT]; SuperLU flags near-singular -> MatrixRankWarning raised as error -> uncaught (only MemoryError caught) -> solve crashes with MatrixRankWarning rather than using the iterative path.
findings.fix: Also catch spla.MatrixRankWarning (and SuperLU RuntimeError) and set x=None to fall through to the GMRES branch.

findings.summary: Safety factors ignore fixed-support nodes, so a peak stress at a constraint does not reduce the reported print safety factor.
findings.scenario: Cantilever fixed face has vm=80 MPa at support but only 30 MPa away; code reports sf_filament=50/30=1.67 despite 80 MPa exceeding 50 MPa.
findings.fix: Include support nodes in the peak used for SFs, or report a support-limited SF when support_peak_exceeds is true.

findings.summary: Fatigue safety-factor card uses the 'away from support' value while the life card uses the global minimum (which sits at the rigid-support singularity), so the two cards describe different locations.
findings.scenario: fatigue_on_support true, away sf=5.0 but sf_min at support gives life_min=1e3 -> card shows 'sf 5' next to 'life 1e3 cycles' (contradictory/misleading).
findings.fix: Track and display a matching fatigue_life_min_away when the min safety factor is on a support, or use the raw global values for both cards.

findings.summary: New template IDs and labels have no i18n entries in ja/en/zh, so summary/UI can render raw keys or raise KeyError.
findings.scenario: User opens template list in Japanese; summary() looks up template.hertz-cylinder.title / param.block_gap / face.cyl_surface and the key is absent.
findings.fix: Add template.<id>.title/description and param/face label keys to all three i18n JSON files.

findings.summary: Offline check returns a reduced dict missing latest/notes/date/page/size/pip/checked_at keys used by the update dialog.
findings.scenario: User enables offline mode and opens Check for updates; frontend reads result.notes[lang] or result.latest and gets undefined/KeyError.
findings.fix: Return the same complete shape as the normal path, with empty/default values for unavailable fields.

findings.summary: The offline notice is gated on `u.offline`, so a response that only sets `offline_mode` shows no offline message.
findings.scenario: Starting with NOVASTUDIO_OFFLINE=1, updates.check can return {offline_mode:true, available:false}; opening Help then shows only the Check button with no explanation.
findings.fix: Gate the block with `u?.offline_mode || u?.offline` and select the message from that combined state.

findings.scenario: Open Help in en/ja/zh; the dialog renders raw keys such as `help.privacy` instead of translated text.
findings.fix: Add these keys to all three i18n JSON files; the existing set-equality test does not verify that a key exists.

findings.summary: PrintCheckSection's effect deps omit the material preset/solid, so switching between printable materials keeps stale print-check data.
findings.scenario: PLA case results shown; user changes materials.solid.preset to 'petg' (applicable stays true, r unchanged) -> no refetch, table still shows PLA strengths and safety factors.
findings.fix: Add preset (or solid) to the useEffect dependency array, or key the section by preset.

findings.summary: Hertz bbox height uses h+min(h,r), which is only the true total height (block h + cylinder protrusion r) while r<=h; for r>h the cylinder top lies outside the returned dims.
findings.scenario: hertz with height=2mm, radius=5mm: dims z-extent = 2+min(2,5)=4mm, but the half-cylinder built from radius 5 reaches 2+5=7mm, so camera framing and any bbox-derived mesh sizing/clipping are wrong.
findings.fix: Use h+r (cylinder centred on the block top) or clamp per the actual mesher construction, and keep dims consistent with job['radius']/job['block_height'].

findings.summary: Buckling result formatting assumes critical_load_n exists whenever load_factor is present, so get_results can raise KeyError instead of reporting results.
findings.scenario: A buckling run returns modes=[{mode:1, load_factor:2.1}] without critical_load_n -> KeyError -> get_results tool fails.
findings.fix: Check for both keys or use .get with a fallback before formatting.

findings.summary: Buckling sections are now routed through the modal branch and read data['mode_shapes'][mode-1]; if buckling results are stored under a different key/shape this raises an unhandled KeyError.
findings.scenario: Run a buckling analysis, then request a section view for mode 1 -> KeyError('mode_shapes') -> 500 instead of a StudioError, section unavailable.
findings.fix: Confirm the buckling result key/shape; otherwise raise StudioError('err.path', 400, path='section interpolation').

findings.summary: Contact-pair fields are stored without validating 'type' (PAIR_TYPES is imported but never used) and without numeric coercion of 'mu'/'search', so arbitrary values reach the case file and the solver.
findings.scenario: PUT contact_pairs.a.type='glued' or contact_pairs.a.mu='0.2' -> invalid pair persisted; solver silently treats it as another contact model or pair_settings float() raises -> wrong contact stiffness or HTTP 500.
findings.fix: Reject type not in PAIR_TYPES (or pass PAIR_TYPES to pair_settings) and coerce/validate mu, search as finite floats before saving.

findings.summary: ContactPairsSettings calls p.case.template.startsWith without a guard; a missing/null template throws and crashes the Boundaries panel.
findings.scenario: A case payload whose case.template is null/undefined (legacy case or some imported assembly) -> TypeError in render -> BoundariesStep fails, properties panel blank.
findings.fix: Use (p.case.template ?? '').startsWith('import-') or optional-chain the check.

findings.summary: New user-facing messages (numbers-only notice, detect_contacts, print_check) are hardcoded English and ignore the language parameter.
findings.scenario: language="ja" or "zh" with render_view/detect_contacts/print_check -> summary text is English, unlike localized UI.
findings.fix: Add i18n keys and use t(...) with the provided language.

findings.summary: Zero strength overrides are silently ignored because the code tests truthiness instead of None, so invalid input falls back to defaults.
findings.scenario: API caller passes strength_xy_mpa=0; `if strength_xy_mpa:` is false, PLA default 50 MPa is used and a plausible result is returned instead of err.print_check_strength.
findings.fix: Use `is not None` for both overrides, then validate that the resulting strengths are positive.

findings.summary: Buckling/contact load parameters allow zero, but zero preload makes linear buckling and Hertz contact singular.
findings.scenario: User sets column-buckling x1.force or hertz-cylinder load.force to 0; the solver divides by zero or fails to converge.
findings.fix: Set the lower bound above zero for load fields in these templates and validate zero preload.

findings.summary: _set_contact_pair subscripts cfg['type']/cfg['mu'] assuming value is a full dict; a per-field path like contact_pairs.foo.mu (float) or a missing key raises uncaught TypeError/KeyError -> 500.
findings.scenario: contact_pairs.foo.mu=0.3 -> cfg is a float, cfg['type'] raises TypeError: 'float' object is not subscriptable, uncaught -> 500.
findings.fix: Require/validate that value is a dict with the needed keys (merge with existing pair) before subscripting, raising StudioError('err.path',400).

findings.summary: print_check accepts lang but never passes it to printcheck.check, so the print-strength verdict text cannot be localized.
findings.scenario: English or Chinese UI -> print check result messages come back in the default (ja) language.
findings.fix: Pass lang to printcheck.check (or localize the returned messages in print_check).

findings.summary: open_sample indexes pl['case']['physics']['kind'] directly and only applies the sample material when it equals 'linear-static'; a missing/different field either raises or silently leaves the default material.
findings.scenario: wall_hook.stl loaded -> physics has no 'kind' -> KeyError (sample fails), or kind != 'linear-static' -> PLA preset not applied -> hook analyzed with the default material, wrong stress/margin.
findings.fix: Use pl['case']['physics'].get('kind') and verify the preset key, or apply the material unconditionally for that template.

findings.summary: Scratch case folders created under root/'runs'/<job>_<tag> live outside the job folder, so deleting the job folder never removes them.
findings.scenario: Many runs from a non-ASCII workspace path -> each leaves root/runs/<id>_<tag>/of behind -> unbounded disk growth in the data/temp folder.
findings.fix: Record the scratch path for cleanup with the job (or delete it when the job finishes/fails).

findings.summary: Averaged master normal is normalized by its length without guarding against a zero-length vector, producing NaN contact normals.
findings.scenario: A master node whose incident outward normals cancel (sharp/concave interface feature) gives nv[master]==0 -> n/0 = NaN -> NaN in contact residual/matrix, silently corrupting the solve.
findings.fix: mask = norm>eps; n[mask] /= norm[mask,None]; leave/zero the rest or skip such nodes.

findings.summary: _project only considers the k=8 nearest master-element centroids and has no fallback expansion when none of them yield a hit.
findings.scenario: Slave point over a large or anisotropic master element whose centroid is not among the 8 nearest -> Newton never converges inside an element -> returns element -1 (no contact) -> contact gap falsely treated as open.
findings.fix: If no candidate hits, expand the KDTree query (e.g. k*=4 or radius=search) and retry before returning -1.

findings.summary: running_port returns the port from running.json without verifying it belongs to the process holding app.lock, so a second start can open a stale port before the lock holder publishes its new one.
findings.scenario: The app crashes leaving running.json port 5000; instance A starts and acquires the lock but has not yet published; instance B starts, fails to acquire, reads stale 5000, and opens a browser window against a dead port.
findings.fix: Publish running.json before serving/handling launches, or retry until the file's pid/mtime matches the lock holder; validate the lock before trusting the port.

findings.summary: Per-body material() returns None (fatigue silently skipped) when body_materials/body_props lack entries, even though the global solid material is a valid metal preset.
findings.scenario: Multi-body model, single global material 'steel', evaluate called with body id -> preset None, base None, own {} -> su/se None -> return None -> no fatigue results.
findings.fix: Fall back to the case-level material/base_preset when per-body data is absent.

findings.summary: Only `s` is checked in results.npz before directly reading `vm`, so a missing von Mises array raises KeyError instead of a handled StudioError.
findings.scenario: A results.npz containing `s` but lacking `vm` causes an uncaught KeyError/HTTP 500 during print checking.
findings.fix: Check `"vm" in d.files` alongside `"s"` and raise err.print_check_scope if either is missing.

findings.summary: Many new i18n keys (result.fatigue_*, result.buckles_below_load, result.buckling_imperfection, card.critical_load/load_factor/applied_load/fatigue_*, err.contact_pair_none/buckling_failed/buckling_none, job.contact_search) are referenced but not shown added to en/ja/zh catalogs.
findings.scenario: ja/zh UI run with fatigue/buckling -> t() returns the raw key, showing 'result.fatigue_fail' instead of a message.
findings.fix: Add all new keys to every language catalog.

findings.summary: primary_quantity for template 'fatigue-bar' returns fatigue_sf_min, a quantity that is singular at fully fixed supports, so the mesh-convergence study cannot converge.
findings.scenario: fatigue-bar with a gripped end: refining the mesh keeps lowering fatigue_sf_min toward 0 -> GCI monotonicity/pass fails on a correct model.
findings.fix: Track a support-removed quantity such as fatigue_sf_min_away (or max_disp) for the study instead of the singular minimum.

findings.summary: mortar_pairs records are appended to m['_contact_pairs'] alongside split_mesh pairs that have a different key schema, so the incremental contact solver may misread or crash.
findings.scenario: case with contact_pairs + bonded contacts -> run_incremental receives records missing 'master'/'slave'/'normal' keys -> KeyError or wrong contact.
findings.fix: Keep mortar records separate or normalize both to one schema before handing to run_incremental.

findings.summary: The print-check query uses truthiness, so an explicit `xy=0` or `z=0` is dropped from the request.
findings.scenario: `printCheck(id, 0, 5)` sends only `?z=5`; `printCheck(id, 0, 0)` sends no query params, so the server cannot distinguish explicit zero from omitted.
findings.fix: Build the query with `xy !== undefined || z !== undefined` and append each parameter when its value is not `undefined`.
